title: The 5 levels of Claude Code mastery
description: Most people using Claude Code are stuck at level 1 and do not even know it. Level 1 is a giant global CLAUDE.md and a few slash commands. Level 5 is a 24/7 daemon on your machine spinning Claude Code and Codex sessions up and down at will, messaging you on Telegram from anywhere, optimizing their own skills off every transcript overnight, running as actual employees in your business with full observability. In between is splitting context into project files, wiring MCP and scheduled crons, and a shared knowledge base your whole framework evolves from. Where are you on the five levels? Link in bio.
